content.text: Two wakings at 19 months is really common. Plenty of toddlers still do it, especially when they've learned that a feed, a rock, or a parent lying down gets them back to sleep. Try this tonight. When Remy wakes, wait a couple of minutes, then go in. Keep it short and boring: a quiet word and a pat, with no lights, no picking up and no feed. Then leave while they're still a little awake. Do the same thing at both wakings so the response is predictable.
